title: Stock
description: Things you hand over, how many are left, and what is running out.

stat.attentionNote: Out of stock, or below the low level you set
stat.attentionLine: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is low or out} one {# item is low or out} other {# items are low or out}}
stat.valueNote: What you paid for what is left
stat.itemsNote: We keep a count of these
stat.unsoldNote: No booking or event offers these yet. Tap to show them.

toast.created: Item added. Now add the stock you have.

empty.title: No stock yet
empty.body: Add things you hand over, e.g. a programme, bottled water or hire shoes. Bookings and events can then offer them.
empty.attentionBody: Every counted item is above the low level you set.
empty.archivedBody: Items you archive are kept here, out of the way.
empty.noMatchBody: Try another word, or another kind.

dialog.reasonHelp: Say why, so anyone can understand this number later.

reasonPlaceholder.remove: e.g. Broken in the store room

itemDescription: What it is, where it is, and everything that has happened to it.
newDescription: Something you hand over and want to count. You add how many you have next.
untrackedNote: We don't count this item, so it has no stock history. Turn on counting in Details to count it.
ledgerNote: The number in stock is worked out from this list.
ledgerEmpty: Nothing yet. Add stock to start the history.
soldWithHelp: Bookings and events that offer this as an extra. To add it, open the booking or event.
soldWithEmpty: Nothing offers this yet, so it will stay on the shelf.

fact.valueNote: What you paid for what is left
fact.onLoanNote: Given out and not back yet

form.name: Name
form.skuHelp: Optional. The code you already use for it, if any.
form.priceHelp: Put 0 if it comes free with a ticket.
form.costHelp: Only used to work out what your stock is worth.
form.trackedHelp: Turn on for things you can count. Turn off for a service.
form.returnable: It is hired out and comes back
form.returnableHelp: e.g. hire shoes, audio guides. When they come back, they go back into stock.
form.lowAtHelp: Below this number it shows as Running low.
form.whereHelp: A counter can only sell what is kept at its own venue.
form.atCounter: Sell it on its own at the counter
form.atCounterHelp: It shows in Shop at the counter, for customers who just want to buy one.
